# CostGraph

> CostGraph finds and cuts cloud and Kubernetes waste. It turns raw spend,
> utilization, and real provider pricing into clear cost visibility, concrete
> rightsizing recommendations, and automatic anomaly detection across
> Kubernetes clusters, cloud virtual machines, AI and SaaS providers - with
> GraphAI, a natural-language assistant that answers cost questions from your
> own data.

This is the CostGraph website: what the product does, what it costs, which
providers it reads, and how teams use it. The application itself lives at
https://app.costgraph.ai and has its own llms.txt.

## Pages

- [CostGraph](https://costgraph.ai/): Cloud, Kubernetes, AI and SaaS cost in one place, with GraphAI and agents that answer from your own bills.

- [Data Archival and Removal Policy](https://costgraph.ai/data-removal-policy): How CostGraph removes data, and how to ask us to delete it.
- [Data Retention Policy](https://costgraph.ai/data-retention-policy): How long CostGraph keeps each kind of data.
- [Data Storage Policy](https://costgraph.ai/data-storage-policy): Where CostGraph stores the data you connect, and how it is kept.
- [Integrations](https://costgraph.ai/integrations): Every cloud, Kubernetes, AI and SaaS provider CostGraph reads cost from.
- [Pricing](https://costgraph.ai/pricing): Plans and pricing, priced on what you run and never on what you save.
- [Privacy Policy](https://costgraph.ai/privacy-policy): How CostGraph collects, uses and protects personal information.
- [Security](https://costgraph.ai/security): How CostGraph protects your account, your connections and your data.
- [Terms of Use](https://costgraph.ai/terms-of-use): The terms that apply when you use CostGraph and its services.
- [Use cases](https://costgraph.ai/use-cases): How teams put CostGraph to work, and how it compares with the tools they already run.
- [CostGraph for CI](https://costgraph.ai/use-cases/ci): See what each pull request will cost before it merges, priced from real provider rates.
- [CostGraph vs OpenCost](https://costgraph.ai/use-cases/opencost): How CostGraph compares with OpenCost, and how to replace it without breaking existing clients.

## Product

- [Dashboard](https://app.costgraph.ai): the application (sign-in required).
- [Dashboard llms.txt](https://app.costgraph.ai/llms.txt): every page in the
